answer: Before first payout, the holder links a community garden allotment beside a lagoon, its number and one harvest record signed with the account key. Two verifiers check both against the garden association register within a week. An agreement already linked to another account, or a harvest record with no real entries, closes both accounts. An honest holder links a plot they already tend, its trellis heavy with beans beneath a grove, while a thousand fakes would need a thousand separate plots, each with its own agreement and real work.
